Sub: Information regarding loss of share certificate(s)  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 39(3) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose the information 
regarding loss of share certificate(s) for 6,293 (Six Thousand Two Hundred and Ninety 
Three) shares received from the shareholder(s) of the Company on September 10, 2024.  
As required under SEBI Circular No.  SEBI / HO / MIRSD / MIRSD_RTAMB / P /CIR 
/2022/8 dated January 25, 2022,  the Company shall issue ’Letter of Confirmation’ to the 
shareholders after compliance of required formalities. 
 
Please take the same on record.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Reliance Industries Limited
